about.window: 12 months ending 2026-10-17 (ingestion must use a window floor on or before 2025-11-01)
about.registered: 2026-10-17, before urllib3 was ingested into TraceMind (#131)
about.arms: Why-queries R1-R6 are the RANDOM arm: drawn by eval/urllib3/select_queries.py from the committed pool.json with seed 20261017 (see draw.json). H1-H4 are the HAND arm, picked by the author from GitHub. Every query carries `arm`. 6 of the 10 why-queries are random.
about.fields: `expected` is what a correct system returns, decided from GitHub. `predicted` is what the author expects TraceMind to return, a separate guess made to calibrate. `verify` is how a human checks it. Neither `expected` nor `predicted` may be edited after results exist; annotate in a later commit.
about.adjudication: A human decides correctness against GitHub, blind to nothing: the author built both the system and this set, which is why the random arm exists and why #143 asks for a second person. The runner records and grades nothing except `contract`.
about.not_covered: No closed-as-duplicate case: GitHub reports zero duplicates closed in the window.
